tools.name: openalex_resolve_name
tools.description: Resolve a name or partial name to an OpenAlex ID. Returns up to 10 matches with disambiguation hints. ALWAYS use this before filtering by entity — names are ambiguous, IDs are not. Also accepts DOIs directly for quick lookup.

params.name: query
params.description: Name or partial name to resolve. Also accepts DOIs for quick lookup.

params.name: filters
params.description: Narrow autocomplete results with filters. Example: restrict to a specific country or publication year range.

params.name: entity_type
params.description: Entity type to search. Omit for cross-entity search (useful when entity type is unknown).

tools.name: openalex_search_entities
tools.description: Search, filter, sort, or retrieve by ID. Covers all OpenAlex entity types (works, authors, sources, institutions, topics, keywords, publishers, funders). Pass `id` to retrieve a single entity. Otherwise, use `query` and/or `filters` for discovery. Supports keyword search with boolean operators, exact phrase matching, and AI semantic search. Use openalex_resolve_name to resolve names to IDs before filtering. Searches and ID lookups return a curated set of fields by default; pass `select` to overr

params.name: id
params.description: Retrieve a single entity by ID. Supports: OpenAlex ID ("W2741809807"), DOI ("10.1038/nature12373"), ORCID ("0000-0002-1825-0097"), ROR ("https://ror.org/00hx57361"), PMID ("12345678"), PMCID ("PMC1234

params.name: seed
params.description: Deterministic seed for `sample`. Same seed + same filters = same results — pass when reproducibility matters. Has no effect (and is rejected) without `sample`.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort field. Prefix with "-" for descending. Common: "cited_by_count", "-publication_date", "-relevance_score" (default when query present). Note: when combined with a keyword query, an explicit sort o

params.name: query
params.description: Text search query. Supports boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT), quoted phrases ("exact match"), wildcards (machin*), fuzzy matching (machin~1), and proximity ("climate change"~5). Omit for filter-only q

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. Pass to get the next page.

params.name: sample
params.description: Return a random sample of this many entities matching the filters (1-100). Single page only — pagination via `cursor` is not supported with sampling. Overrides `per_page`. Useful for unbiased explorat

params.name: select
params.description: OpenAlex top-level field names to return. Always returned: `id`, `display_name` — additional fields you list are appended. A curated default per entity type applies to both searches and single-entity

params.name: filters
params.description: Filter criteria as field:value pairs. AND across fields (multiple keys). OR within field: pipe-separate ("us|gb"). NOT: prefix "!" ("!us"). Range: "2020-2024". Comparison: ">100", "<50". AND within sa

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page (1-100). Default 25. Semantic search caps at 50 — when search_mode="semantic", set per_page ≤ 50 (also subject to a 1 req/sec rate limit upstream).

params.name: entity_type
params.description: Type of scholarly entity to search.

params.name: search_mode
params.description: Search strategy. "keyword": stemmed full-text (default). "exact": no stemming, matches individual words (use quoted phrases for multi-word exact match). "semantic": AI embedding similarity (max 50 res

tools.name: openalex_analyze_trends
tools.description: Aggregate OpenAlex entities into groups and count them. Use for trend analysis (group works by publication_year), distribution analysis (group by oa_status, type, country), and comparative analysis (group by institution or topic). Combine with filters to scope the analysis. Returns up to 200 groups per page — use cursor pagination for fields with many distinct values.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order for groups. Omit or pass "count" (default) to return the top-N groups by count descending — no further pages. Pass "key" to enumerate all distinct values in key-ascending order with cursor

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. Only relevant when order is "key" — count-descending results have no next page. Pass the next_cursor from the previous response to advance.

params.name: filters
params.description: Filter criteria (same syntax as openalex_search_entities filters). Narrows the population before aggregation. For full-text within filters, use abstract.search, title.search, or default.search — there

params.name: group_by
params.description: Field to group by. Works examples: "publication_year", "type", "oa_status", "primary_topic.field.id", "authorships.institutions.country_code", "is_retracted". Authors: "last_known_institutions.country

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum groups per page (1-200). Default 200 (the upstream cap). A real top-N knob when order is count (the default) — reduce to return only the highest-count groups.

params.name: entity_type
params.description: Entity type to aggregate.

params.name: include_unknown
params.description: Include a group for entities with no value for the grouped field. Hidden by default.

tools.name: openalex_get_citation_graph
tools.description: Walk the citation graph one hop from a seed work. Direction picks the edge: incoming citations (`cites`), the seed's own references (`cited_by`), or OpenAlex's algorithmically-related works (`related_to`). Note: `direction` follows OpenAlex's filter convention, which inverts the common English reading — `cites` returns works that cite the seed; `cited_by` returns works the seed cites. Results use the works schema; combine with filters/sort to narrow further.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort field. Prefix with "-" for descending. Common: "cited_by_count", "-publication_date". Default is OpenAlex relevance.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. Pass to get the next page.

params.name: select
params.description: OpenAlex work field names to return. Always returned: id, display_name. Defaults to the curated works select if omitted.

params.name: filters
params.description: Additional filters to narrow the graph, same syntax as openalex_search_entities. Example: publication_year=">2020", is_oa="true". Do not include cites/cited_by/related_to — those are set by the `direc

params.name: seed_id
params.description: Seed work identifier. Accepts OpenAlex ID ("W2741809807"), DOI ("10.1038/nature12373" or full URL), PMID, or PMCID. Use openalex_resolve_name first if you only have a title.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page (1-100). Default 25.

params.name: direction
params.description: "cites": works that cite seed_id (incoming citations). "cited_by": works that seed_id cites (its reference list). "related_to": OpenAlex algorithmically-related works (~8-30 typical, may be empty for

tools.name: openalex_describe_fields
tools.description: List valid field names for an OpenAlex entity type and context (filter, group_by, or select). Use proactively before constructing a filter or group_by to avoid invalid-field 400 errors. Pass `query` to narrow the results by name similarity — useful when you have a partial or guessed field name.

params.name: query
params.description: Optional partial or guessed field name to rank results by similarity. Pass the field you tried (e.g. "funder") to get the closest matches first. Omit to return all fields for the entity_type + context

params.name: context
params.description: Field usage context. "filter": fields accepted in the filter param. "group_by": fields accepted in group_by — a subset of the filter set (raw date and *.search fields are excluded; they cannot be grou

params.name: entity_type
params.description: OpenAlex entity type to list fields for.

prompts.description: Guides a systematic literature search: formulate query, search, filter, analyze citation network, synthesize findings.
